intro: Supplies for Sven is a bundle of vital provisions packaged in Darkshire and destined for Sven Yorgen's secluded camp. Surrounded by the horrors of Duskwood, Sven and his small band rely on sympathetic townspeople like the Carevin family to sustain their vigil against the shadows.

p: Carrying survival gear and basic necessities through Duskwood is no simple chore. Sven Yorgen and his handful of followers camp in the northwestern wilderness of the woods, far from the safety of Darkshire. Their numbers are so depleted and their watch so demanding that they cannot spare a single fighter to make the trek into town. This parcel represents a lifeline sent by the Carevin family, ensuring that the isolated camp has the food, bandages, and materials needed to hold their ground.
